subject: SIG questionnaire & evidence ask — Halcyon Financial evaluation
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@halcyon.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Halcyon Financial Procurement <procurement@halcyon.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire — control mapping & evidence request for Halcyon evaluation

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking the time during last week's call. As part of our security review for the upcoming procurement approval, we've attached Halcyon's SIG spreadsheet with a focused set of control questions (see attachment: Halcyon_SIG_2028.xlsx). Our legal and infosec team are asking specifically for: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a short control mapping to the SIG rows referencing the SOC2 sections.
- Evidence for key controls: key management (KMS), data residency controls, telemetry/observability (what's captured and retention), incident response and post-incident timelines.
- Any third-party assessments (ISO/IEC 27001 certificate, penetration test summary) that you can share.

We have an internal deadline of 2028-04-05 for vendor packet submission. Can you confirm what you can provide and your expected delivery dates? If there are items that require redaction or NDAs, please call that out so our legal team can coordinate.

Attaching: Halcyon_SIG_2028.xlsx (our crossword of SIG rows we care about).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to coordinate a 20–30 minute walkthrough once you've shared initial artifacts.

Best,
Emily Chen
Vendor Risk Manager | Halcyon Financial
emily.chen@halcyon.com
+1 415-555-0198

--
Halcyon Financial — Procurement team
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire — control mapping & evidence request for Halcyon evaluation

Kim / Neha — forwarding Halcyon's SIG (attached). They've called out SOC2, KMS proofs, telemetry, and incident response. Deal ID HAL-2028-03. RFP packet due 2028-04-05.

Can you do an artifact sweep and produce: 
1) A control crosswalk (SIG row -> control -> artifact filename + owner) — CSV preferred.
2) A redacted SOC2 Type II pdf and short cover memo mapping SOC sections to SIG rows.
3) A small evidence bundle for KMS (key rotation log sample), telemetry schema excerpt (what we log and retention), and incident response runbook excerpt.

Tentative owners: Neha — KMS/telemetry/IR artifacts. Kimberly — SOC2 cover memo + legal redaction needs.

Timeframe: can we get a first draft by EOD Thu (2028-03-23)? If any artifacts need legal review before sharing, flag them and we'll route to legal.

I'll own the external reply and the walkthrough scheduling. Thanks — please include filenames in your reply so I can track.

Markus Klein
Security & Assurance Lead, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0123
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire — control mapping & evidence request for Halcyon evaluation

Markus / Kim — attaching the initial artifact set and crosswalk. See attachments: redacted_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf, kms_key_rotation_log_sample.csv, telemetry_schema_snippet.txt, incident_response_runbook.pdf. I've also uploaded originals to the secure shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/halcyon/sig-evidence-2028 (access limited).

Notes / flags: 
- redacted_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf: redactions applied to customer names and a subset of internal hostnames per policy. Kimberly — please confirm if further redaction is necessary for Halcyon's legal requirements.
- kms_key_rotation_log_sample.csv: sanitized sample showing rotation cadence and key IDs; full audit trail is sensitive and requires a DPA amendment to share outside the evaluation window.
- telemetry_schema_snippet.txt: includes the fields we retain for inference requests (hashed user identifiers only) and retention: 30 days for verbose traces, 365 days for aggregate metrics.
- incident_response_runbook.pdf: public-facing SLAs and the executive notification timeline; detailed forensics procedures are excluded here.

Control crosswalk (control_crosswalk_v1.csv) maps SIG rows to SOC 2 sections and the artifact file name. I've marked three SIG rows as "legal review" where we reference customer-specific logs.

Next steps I recommend: 
- Kimberly to review SOC2 redaction and sign-off on what can be shared.
- If Halcyon needs a signed NDA for anything we excluded, recommend we have Procurement route that now.

Delivery ETA: initial packet items uploaded and attached here. Happy to iterate.

--
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Hi Emily / Halcyon team,

Thanks for the packet — we've uploaded an initial evidence bundle and a control crosswalk that maps the SIG rows you highlighted to our SOC2 sections and supporting artifacts. Summary of what's included in the shared packet: 

- Redwood_HALCYON_SIG_Packet_v1.zip (contains the control_crosswalk_v1.csv and the items below).
- redacted_SOC2_Type2_2027.pdf (redactions applied; Kimberly cc'd for legal confirmation).
- kms_key_rotation_log_sample.csv (sanitized sample).
- telemetry_schema_snippet.txt (fields retained and retention policy excerpt).
- incident_response_runbook.pdf (public IR timelines and notification flows).
- control_crosswalk_v1.csv (SIG row -> SOC2 control -> artifact filename -> owner email).

Access: Full artifact set is on our secure drive (link below). If you need presigned downloads for specific files we can issue time-limited links — let me know which files you need and to what email.

Next steps / ask: 
1) Can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough to run through the crosswalk and call out any follow-ups? I've tentatively opened 2028-03-28 10:00 PT for a walkthrough — calendar link: https://cal.redwood.ai/b/markus/halcyon-sig-walkthrough-20280328
2) Kimberly, please confirm SOC2 redaction scope and call out anything that needs legal escalation.
3) Emily, if there are any required formats or additional third-party artifacts (ISO cert, penetration test summary) please flag and we'll prioritize.

If the packet looks good, we'll convert to a finalized ZIP for your procurement team and track the open SIG rows marked for legal review.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
